question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**premises**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The blank 2 will imply the place where the services are offered to the consumers.**
 
• **Now, among the given options, the correct word to use is "premises."** 
 
 
• "Premises" refers to a building and its surrounding land or property.(परिसर)
 
 
 
• It is commonly used in legal and business contexts to refer to a specific location where an activity takes place.
 
 
• Example: "The premises of the company were searched by the police."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (estate) refers to a large piece of land, often with a large house or other buildings on it.(जागीर)
 
• Option 2 (abode) refers to a person's home or place of residence.(धाम)
 
• Option 3 (places) is a general term that can refer to any location or area, without specifying any particular property or building.(स्थानों)
